fato_historico: 1932: George Lansbury became the leader of the opposition British Labour Party.

Consider how your leadership shines; it may be the perfect moment to inspire those around you and lead with your natural, radiant courage.
frase_do_dia: Your voice carries the weight of a thousand dreams, believe in your power today.
